_about: Field terms for F308, same shape as papers/glossary.json.

oeis.definition: the On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences, a public database of number sequences in which each entry carries the first terms, formulas, comments and links contributed by many people
oeis.excludes: a peer-reviewed journal; a line in an entry is a contribution, and a conjecture line in it carries no proof

b-file.definition: a text file stored beside an OEIS entry that lists the sequence's index and term pairs much further than the entry's own data section, often to thousands of terms
b-file.excludes: the entry's data section, which holds only the first few dozen terms

conjecture-line.definition: a comment or formula line in an OEIS entry that states an equation for the sequence and labels it a conjecture; most were found by fitting the terms then known
conjecture-line.excludes: a line marked as proved, and a statement with no equation

linear-recurrence.definition: an equation that gives each term of a sequence as a fixed weighted sum of a set number of earlier terms, possibly with terms in n; here with integer coefficients
linear-recurrence.excludes: an equation with a product of earlier terms, and an equation with coefficients that are not integers

counterexample.definition: a single case where a general statement is false; one is enough to refute a conjecture
counterexample.excludes: a term that disagrees because the data are wrong

ast-whitelist.definition: a rule that turns each line into a syntax tree and accepts it only if every part is on a fixed list: integers, n, the terms a(n-k), addition, subtraction, multiplication and powers
ast-whitelist.excludes: any line that needs division, sums, named functions or words to state

sampling-frame.definition: the list from which a sample is drawn; a result describes the frame, so a change of frame changes what the result is about

deviation.definition: a dated, recorded change from the preregistered plan, stated with its reason and with what had been seen when it was made
deviation.excludes: a change made silently, and a change made after seeing the outcome it would affect without saying so

wilson.definition: a 95 percent interval for a proportion, found by inverting the score test; it stays inside 0 to 1 and behaves well when the count is small or near zero
wilson.excludes: the simple interval of the proportion plus or minus 1.96 standard errors, which fails near zero
